notes: Product configuration. Writes are scoped to PRJ; project instructions, credentials and repository controls remain protected by the runtime.

The PostgreSQL-backed PRJ backend test is required on every approved execution. Linux uses Bubblewrap and macOS uses sandbox-exec with an isolated studio_test cluster and an offline dependency cache prepared from the base checkout.
Browser E2E requires an API/web/PostgreSQL stack and Playwright browser. It is recorded as explicitly skipped until a dedicated isolated service runner is implemented.
Codex CLI version 0.171.0 is pinned in this configuration and checked against the runner's installed CLI before a task executes.

gpt-6.2-sol is configured as the project model. Codex CLI user configuration is loaded; the project model and runtime safety options remain explicit. Account/model availability is checked by the CLI at execution time; do not record credentials in configuration or logs.
Candidate modifications are retained in the engine's external workspace, not automatically applied to the original demo or PRJ.
